hooks.name: UX Testing
hooks.description: After agent execution that touched view files, visually test brick views using Playwright.

action.prompt:
If no mcp/views.py or mcp/views_tabs.py files were changed, skip silently.

If view files changed:
1. `uv pip install -e .` then use Playwright to screenshot each changed view
2. Evaluate: visual balance, hierarchy, readability, flow, consistency, polish
3. List specific suggestions. Do NOT make changes.
